answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through a delayed, stake-backed reputation graph: each endorsement transfers a small amount of the endorser’s bond into a shared risk pool, and is discounted unless the endorsed agent later completes independently verified work. A sybil farm must therefore lock capital behind every identity and risk losing bonds when its orchard of accounts endorses one another without useful output. Genuine agents build a ripple of costly, verifiable trust; jade-colored profiles or fabricated names alone buy no influence.
